name: Crude Flint
summary: Across the Wetlands, Mosshide gnolls burn living marsh timber, and Rethiel the Greenwarden means to stop them. They carry Crude Flint to kindle their fires.

sections.title: Kindling in the Mire
sections.body: Mosshide gnolls strike Crude Flint for warmth and to cook meat in the damp Wetlands. They cut down living timber for their hearths and bonfires. Rethiel the Greenwarden sees every spark as an assault on the marsh's natural balance.

sections.title: The Greenwarden's Retribution
sections.body: Rethiel the Greenwarden seeks to stop the Mosshide gnolls from cutting down the marsh's trees. He asks passing adventurers to take the firestones from the pack. Then he plans to smash each flint to dust and cast the fragments into the sea, so the gnolls can no longer burn the Wetlands' living wood.

faq.q: What is Crude Flint used for?
faq.answer: Mosshide gnolls strike Crude Flint for sparks to keep warm and cook meat. Rethiel the Greenwarden asks travelers to gather the flints and stop them from setting living trees aflame.

Most adult and specialized Mosshide gnolls carry Crude Flint. They include Mosshide Brutes, Trappers, Fenrunners, Mistweavers, Mystics, Alphas, and Gnawbone. Smaller Mosshide gnolls and mongrels do not carry it.

faq.q: Why does Rethiel want the flints destroyed?
faq.answer: Rethiel the Greenwarden is horrified that the gnolls cut down living wetland trees and burn the wood for warmth. He plans to destroy their flints and cast the shards into the sea, leaving them without a way to spark fires.

faq.q: Are these flints valuable for crafting?
aliases: can i use crude flint in blacksmithing
faq.answer: No. Crude Flint is a rough stone suited only to sparking a crude flame. It lacks the purity and shape smiths and engineers need.

angles.text: As a druid, you know that cutting down living plants for gnoll comfort offends nature's tenets. Taking and shattering the firestones is a natural duty for a guardian of the wild.
